title: Tournaments with Managerial Discretion
abstract: arXiv:2609.04068v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study tournaments with managerial discretion in hiring. A manager selects a coworker from a pool of candidates and then competes against him in a Lazear--Rosen--style tournament with a prize equal to a share of total output. A profit-maximizing principal sets the prize share together with a head start (or handicap)---an advantage (or disadvantage) in the output comparison---granted to the manager. The head start affects output through three channels: (i) encouraging the manager, (ii) discouraging the new hire, and (iii) inducing the manager to hire a stronger candidate. The hiring effect dominates the discouragement effect until the strongest candidate is hired; beyond that point, any further head start discourages the new hire more than it encourages the manager. The optimal contract therefore grants a head start just large enough to induce the manager to hire the strongest candidate.

translated_title: 具有管理者自由裁量权的锦标赛
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在招聘中赋予管理者自由裁量权的锦标赛。管理者从候选人池中挑选一名同事，然后在Lazear-Rosen式锦标赛中与其竞争，奖金等于总产出的一定份额。一个利润最大化的委托人设定奖金份额，并同时给予管理者一个先发优势（或劣势）——即在产出比较中的优势（或劣势）。先发优势通过三个渠道影响产出：（i）激励管理者，（ii）挫败新员工的积极性，以及（iii）促使管理者招聘更强的候选人。在招聘到最强候选人之前，招聘效应始终压倒挫败效应；超过这一点之后，任何进一步的先发优势对新员工的挫败作用都将超过对管理者的激励作用。因此，最优合同所给予的先发优势恰好足以促使管理者招聘最强的候选人。
tldr: 该论文研究了管理者可自主挑选竞争对手的锦标赛模型，证明了最优合同应给予管理者恰好足以促使其招聘最强候选人的先发优势，因为在达到这一点之前，招聘效应（促使招聘更强候选人）始终压倒对新员工的挫败效应。
en_tdlr: In tournaments where a manager selects his own competitor, the optimal contract grants the manager just enough head start to induce hiring the strongest candidate, since the hiring effect dominates the discouragement effect up to that point.
